title: Loofah
description: Loofah is a SpongeAPI implementation for the Fabric ecosystem based on upstream SpongeCommon
body:
Loofah
======
**Unofficial** Fabric port of the official SpongeAPI implementation. Loofah implements the SpongeAPI by building the necessary Fabric specific components around the official SpongeCommon implementation of the SpongeAPI. This allows us to more fully implement the API (since the majority of the implementation is the official implementation) compared to earlier attempts at a Fabric port and follows the convention adopted by upstream.

Loofah is **_not_** affiliated with the official Sponge project! We build on top of the same core but are **_not_** officially endorsed or supported by upstream! Any and all issues with Loofah should be pointed to the [Loofah issue tracker](https://github.com/LoofahMC/Loofah/issues) and **_not_** upstream.
